reviews.title: Just terrible
reviews.text: The business and website itself is a great alternative to Goodreads but my god is this iOS app just terrible. The search hardly works and it feels like a lazy web-app port. Please please have a developer rewrite it for iOS

reviews.title: I want to like you
reviews.text: I realllly want to like this app, and the concept as a whole is nice(plus my book club uses this one). But UI is not aesthetically appealing. It gives all business, no whimsy. Additionally, the app loads super slow, and glitchy. Even after sitting on the home page for a couple minutes and then trying to crash the app(and all my others I had open) it still won’t load anything.

reviews.title: Bad UI
reviews.text: They’re incorrectly caching pages between menu items. So if you go to challenges back to home, you’re still shown the challenges page unless you hit the home icon a second time. Amateur hour on this app.

reviews.title: Slow Loading Speed
reviews.text: The UI design is clean and I like charts and tags to give you a better idea of a books structure and theme, but the app was running so slow and had to constantly swap from one tab to another to load the screen. The UX using the app was poor and hope the loading speed improves as it can be frustrating.

reviews.title: Can’t scan my books
reviews.text: First time user here, and I really wanted to love the app since a friend had walked me through theirs—but it’s taken a half hour just to get the first 8 books of my collection scanned. ISBN and book covers seem to overwhelm the search system and it crashes out and errors. Goodreads is really intuitive when scanning ISBNs but I would like an alternative, I love LibraryThing for inventory, but maybe I’ll switch to that for the time being. This app was mostly a let down.

reviews.title: Too buggy
reviews.text: StoryGraph I truly want to love you but you’re making it difficult. For the past couple of weeks the loading time has taken ages and today it hasn’t loaded at all. I just want to log my reading and feel accomplished marking a book as finished. Help a girl out and fix the problems! Please!

reviews.title: Extremely Buggy
reviews.text: I’ve been using the website app  for a week and decided to download the iOS app today. It’s not good, and does not work well. It lags, it makes me log in multiple times, and the back button at the top does not work. The UI is poorly designed in the search bar, with the barcode and search button overlapping. When you tap an icon for a page you’re already on because you can’t go backwards due to the button not working, it goes into an endless loading spiral. I’m going back to the website app, because this app needs a ton of work. It is basically unusable.

reviews.title: Cool Concept
reviews.text: It’s a cool concept and I got excited when I could export my Goodreads information… but that’s where it got muddy. It didn’t import my stuff correctly. It imported some of my books as Dutch language or non print books. The whole reason I wanted to check the app out was for the cool graphics and they’re not correct. I don’t feel like adjusting everything myself so I decided just to stick with Goodreads (they’re free) I understand that’s how you make your money to further develop but it’s honestly so annoying this day and age. I want to be able to enjoy stuff without having to pay for it to work better.. Plus the current AI implements just make not want to return to the app at all.

reviews.title: Profoundly frustrating
reviews.text: I want to love this app but the UI is god awful. I put in a book and it automatically says I’ve finished it. It supposedly keeps track of pages read but doesn’t. So poorly designed.

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Useless junk! You can’t import any of your Goodreads books.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: I was using this app to compare tracking my reading to other apps. Life happened and I needed to get a new phone, and when I downloaded the app and logged in all of my data was gone. I am very disappointed as before that I was thoroughly enjoying the app.

reviews.title: Terrible Service and Support
reviews.text:
StoryGraph completely lacks a public code of conduct or community guidelines page to protect readers and authors. Even Goodreads, their biggest competitor, has these basic safety guardrails in place.

When you reach out to support about serious issues, the response time is incredibly slow, only to be met with unhelpful deflections from Abbie. StoryGraph actively allows its platform to be used for targetted harassment under the bizarre loophole that if a user labels defamatory, real world and personal accusations that have nothing to do with the book’s text as a "DNF" note, it’s suddenly protected.

I originally left Goodreads to support a smaller, independent app, but that is proving to be a mistake. As the platform grows, their support team’s refusal to address blatant defamation shows they simply do not care about community safety, and I will no longer be recommending goodreaders to make the switch to this app. Support does NOT CARE.

reviews.title: No instructions?
reviews.text: I’m not into computers. I love to read and just wanted to track my reading. And maybe some recommendations. But apparently you’re just supposed to know how to use the app? With no guidance. After asking the internet many times how to simply and add book with no clear answer. I deleted the app. I’ll just keep writing my information down on paper.

reviews.title: I can’t pretend anymore
reviews.text: I loved this app when it first came out. I liked the stats and the recommendations, so I was willing to overlook the clunkiness of the app since it was brand new. I can’t excuse all the issues anymore. The app barely ever loads, and when it does it’s incredibly slow. The interface is still clunky and inconvenient. The autofill on the search function is absolutely abysmal. There’s been little improvement with these issues. In fact, I feel like everything has gotten worse in the last 3 years. I’m really only keeping it for the reading challenges and monthly stats images. I never go through my recommendations anymore. It’s never the first app I open to log or rate a book. It’s unfortunate because I really did adore Storygraph when I first got it. I’ve never even used goodreads (and never will) so this isnt a comparison thing. I just want an app that’s functional, and storygraph barely is now.

reviews.title: Unreliable glitchy app - please help!
reviews.text: I love StoryGraph and I really wish to keep using it, but the app is not working at all and I cannot easily access any contact details or app support. Nothing loads and all I get is a grey screen with a loading circle no matter which page I select. I tried to get in touch with app support in a browser on the webpage but it kept redirecting me to the app where it would once again show a stuck loading screen and no other working functions. I’m getting frustrated after trying several times over the last few days :(

reviews.title: stop logging me out
reviews.text: every time i open it, it has logged me out and for some reason the login refuses to save across my apple devices so when im in the middle of a bookstore trying to check a book on the app it becomes literally useless :)

reviews.title: Not easy to use
reviews.text: When setting up, it didn’t give you details directions on how to import from goodreads, or any info on how often to update…if you need to, how to use the app to get the results you want. So I deleted the app, because it is not user friendly to explain how to do those things. Also why should I have to download a file and upload it in the first place? They need an interface to interact and sync with Amazon or goodreads.

reviews.title: Lacks many titles
reviews.text: If you are looking for a book somewhat recent don't expect to find it here. If you would like to look up a particular author and review all their publications, this app will not help you. It probably has other virtues but it generally did not help me due to missing content.

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: Very poor. I moved here from Goodreads. And have regretted it ever since. Basics, like searching for books, don’t work. I’ll put the full title in the search, and the search results will be a short list of books. With none of the words I typed in their title? It’s also extremely slow. Going from page to page takes forever. It’s not designed intuitively either. I keep hoping after each update that it improves, but it seems to get worse. If it worked well I would be happy to subscribe.

reviews.title: Not accessible
reviews.text: I would love to root for this app and fully jump ship from GR. Unfortunately, as someone who is visually impaired, I am going to have to rate this lower. The text is so small and I can’t seem to find any settings to enlarge the text within the app. My own phone’s accessibility settings such as increasing font size in apps also does not work when using StoryGraph. So I just have to use my phone’s zoom controller to zoom in every time I want to read some text, and it also makes leaving a review really annoying. So my experience with this app is completely not enjoyable. However, if you are not visually impaired then I’m sure you’ll love this app.

reviews.title: Where are the foreign books?
reviews.text: I tried it for a year and even though the app is decent I am tired of adding Italian books to its database. Many of them are just missing, despite being printed by famous publishers. I wanted to love this app but it’s just very disappointing.

reviews.title: Mood pie chart
reviews.text: Please change the moods back to a. Pie chart please. It looks so cramped as a bar chart
